decisions.reason: Per-location management control does not change the existing Wix Bookings platform requirement; access isolation is already owned by the source Requirement.
Per-location operational control does not alter the master site's role, location routing, or navigation behavior.
The control decision does not modify the reusable template structure or its support for adding franchise locations.
Location management control does not change the Smash Room brand name or its application across sites.
The operational-control clause does not change the competitor reference, simple layout, or navigation-oriented visual direction.
